'''Starck''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], Starck served in the [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] attack group under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], commanding the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] [[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]] and its group during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. In the prelude to the engagement, Starck attempted to impress [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] by taking Blizzard 4 and the accompanying walkers on a direct yet treacherous route through [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]], which resulted in the loss of three walkers to shifting [[Water/Legends|ice]] flows. Starck survived and regrouped with the rest of Blizzard Force. During the engagement with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces, Blizzard 4 was destroyed by Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

==Biography==
[[File:Blizzard4.png|thumb|left|200px|Starck commanded Blizzard 4 during the Battle of Hoth.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="FFG" /> Starck served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]], a ground assault [[unit]] assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] by<ref name="Worlds" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Starck commanded the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] designated [[Blizzard 4/Legends|Blizzard 4]], along with its accompanying group of [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].<ref name="Worlds" /> When in battle, Blizzard 4 was charged with conquering terrain not covered by the primary assault and deploying [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to secure the area.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Reflections III|cardname=Blizzard 4}}</ref> The Empire had recently discovered the presence of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], but the presence of a strong [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] negated the effect of any [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]]. Blizzard Force was deployed to Hoth's surface, tasked with destroying the Rebels' [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] and any resistance they met.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

The [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] transporting Blizzard Force landed in the [[Moorsh Moraine/Legends|Moorsh Moraine]] located to the north of the Rebel base. The assault force emerged from the moraine into the [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]]; while the other groups took a safe yet indirect westerly pathway through the valley, Starck opted for a direct route in an effort to impress [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The move proved disastrous, as Starck lost three of the group's walkers to [[Water/Legends|ice]] flows. Blizzard 4's group reunited with the main attack force on the [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]]. From the top of the ridge they commenced their [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attack]] on the Rebel base.<ref name="Worlds" /> In the midst of the battle, Blizzard 4 crushed Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] disabled [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] after it had crashed in front of the walker. Skywalker used a [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon gun]] to ascended to the underside of the AT-AT, cut open a small hatch with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]],<ref name="ESB" /> and threw a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]<ref name="FFG" /> into the compartment before falling to the snow below. Blizzard 4 proceeded forward, but its advance was cut short when the grenade detonated a short amount of [[Time/Legends|time]] later. The walker's head exploded,<ref name="ESB" /> and Starck's command was cut short.<ref name="FFG" /> What remained of the walker collapsed to the ground.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
After landing on Hoth, Colonel Starck attempted to impress the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader by taking his AT-AT group on a treacherous route through the Kerane Valley. Though the Colonel survived, the move resulted in the loss of three walkers to ice flows, and Starck was forced to regroup with the rest of the assault force.<ref name="Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Starck was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'', a reference book released in [[2004]].<ref name="Worlds" /> Though Blizzard 4 was destroyed during the Battle of Hoth,<ref name="ESB" /> Starck's fate was left unclear. [[Holocron continuity database]] maintainer [[Leland Chee]] stated "Colonel Starck is certainly dead by my book" when asked about the subject on his Facebook blog.<ref name="Chee Facebook">{{Facebook|username=Keeper-of-the-Holocron|name=[[Leland Chee]]|date=2011-07-07|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=231839790170288&id=793375187|nobackup=true}}</ref>
